hints.title: Index Derivation via Counting
hints.text: The final index of any element in a sorted list is determined solely by how many elements are smaller than it.

hints.title: Contiguous Target Range
hints.text: All occurrences of target will occupy consecutive indices starting at less_count.

hints.title: Direct Index Generation
hints.text: Count items smaller than target and equal to target, then generate the index range directly.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Count elements less than target and elements equal to target to directly generate indices.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting the entire array takes O(N log N) time whereas counting takes O(N).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting frequencies bypasses full array reordering completely.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that sorting is unnecessary when target is fixed.
